audience.question: Who is RoleCue for?
audience.answer: RoleCue is for people preparing for technical interviews, whether you’re starting out or moving to a new role.

gettingStarted.question: What do I need to get started?
gettingStarted.answer: Create an account, bring a target job description, and have a microphone ready for the spoken interview.

jobDescription.question: Are the questions based on my job description?
jobDescription.answer: Yes. RoleCue uses the technical context in your job description to guide the interview. Later questions also respond to your answers.

interviewer.question: Can I choose my interviewer?
interviewer.answer: Yes. For your own practice sessions, choose an available system or personal 3D avatar and a voice profile.

afterSession.question: What do I get after a session?
afterSession.answer: You get an interview report with an evaluation of your technical responses, so you can review your attempt and see what to improve.

free.question: Can I start for free?
free.answer: Creating an account is free. Starting a practice session costs 5 coins.

closing.text: A little practice before the real conversation.

pages.pricingTitle: Coins for the work you do.
pages.pricingIntro: Use a personal wallet for interview practice, recruitment slots and avatar storage. Choose a coin package when you need it.
pages.privacyIntro: How information moves through practice and recruitment in RoleCue.
pages.termsIntro: A guide to accounts, coins and interview sessions on RoleCue.
pages.draftNotice: This information is a draft for project and legal review. The final policy has not yet been published.
pages.catalogIntro: Available packages and prices come from the current RoleCue catalog. Sign in to purchase from your wallet.
pages.pricingSectionTitle: A clear cost at each step.
pages.practiceBody: A practice session costs 5 coins when it starts. Returning to the same active session does not incur another charge.
pages.recruitmentBody: Recruiters fund interview slots at 1 coin each. A candidate uses a prepaid slot when their recruitment interview starts; the candidate is not charged. Eligible unused slots are returned as coins to the recruiter’s wallet when the posting closes completely.
pages.avatarBody: An additional avatar storage slot costs 1 coin. Creating an avatar has no separate generation fee when a storage slot is available.
pages.informationBody: RoleCue uses account details and the information you provide for your role profiles, job postings and applications to support the relevant workflows.
pages.practiceDataBody: Practice uses your role context and spoken answers to produce an interview report. Practice sessions do not record video.
pages.recruitmentDataBody: Recruitment interviews use camera and microphone recording. Candidates are told before starting. Recording status is visible to the candidate; playback is limited to the owning recruiter under the application review rules.
pages.accessBody: The product decision specifies deletion of recruitment recordings 90 days after the application’s final decision. The automated deletion job is not yet implemented. Detailed retention, access and privacy rights require confirmation before publication.
pages.accountBody: Candidates and recruiters use their own accounts for practice and recruitment. Provide accurate information and use the service responsibly.
pages.coinsBody: Candidates and recruiters have personal coin wallets. Package prices and coin amounts are shown in the current catalog. Coin spending and eligible unused recruitment-slot returns are internal wallet transactions.
pages.sessionsBody: Starting practice costs 5 coins. A recruitment interview uses a recruiter-funded slot and requires camera and microphone recording. Resuming the same active session does not incur a second charge or slot.
pages.responsibilityBody: Payment, cancellation, technical disruption and other legal terms require project owner and legal review. This draft does not establish a cash refund policy.
pages.catalogSignIn: Sign in and complete your account setup to see current packages and prices in your wallet.
